name: story
description: AI-native project management for coding agents. A full story lifecycle: bare `/story` lists ready stories to pick from, `/story new` files one, `/story do <id>` dispatches a ready story to a fresh plan-mode Claude session in a new tmux window + per-story git worktree, and `/story complete <id>` closes it and safely reclaims the worktree and merged branch. `/story work`, `/story context`, and friends cover the rest of the session lifecycle. Proactive story tracking, session handoffs, and dependency-aware task selection via the storyhook CLI.

storyhook.description: Curated story-lifecycle tools (list, next, new, move, comment, and more — see `story help mcp`) over the same door the CLI and web dashboard use. Every tool call names its own `project`; this server infers nothing from a working directory.
